Posted: 2026-08-15
U.S. stocks closed lower on Friday, August 14, as Wall Street pulled back from record highs. The Dow fell 107 points, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq also declined. Investors weighed weaker U.S. retail sales, rising oil prices and geopolitical tensions as markets ended a strong week. For more details, watch our story and subscribe to our channel, DRM News.
